name: Upbit-Binance premium arbitrage with 4-balance allocator and wall filter
author: Leewonwuk
license: Source terms apply; paraphrased summary only
instruments_timeframes: Seconds-level multi-coin websockets; operated Mar-Aug 2025 then archived because premium compressed (per README).
indicators: Upbit KRW price, Binance USDT mid, USDT/KRW FX, taker buy ratio
entry_long: premium = (upbit_price_krw - binance_mid x USDTKRW)/binance_mid. If premium > entry_threshold AND expected_profit = notional x (kimchi_premium(vs binance ask) - (upbit_fee + binance_fee + slippage legs)) > 0 AND not blocked by order-book wall (taker buy ratio filter) -> sell coin on Upbit, buy on Binance (TRADE_KIMCHI).
entry_short: Reverse premium (premium < -threshold) -> buy Upbit, sell Binance.
exit: Trade is a simultaneous two-leg round; inventory rebalanced via REBALANCE_B_TO_U / U_TO_B when balance imbalance exceeds a threshold and daily rebalance limit not reached (transfer fee in coin units).
stop_loss: No price stop; risk is inventory/transfer and leg latency
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
implementation_notes: Thresholds live in YAML configs not captured; code in capital_allocator.py. Same repo also has v2 BTCUSDT-vs-BTCUSDC and v3 funding strategies.
